questions.q: Which of the following were among the first five Sikhs (Panj Pyare) initiated by Guru Gobind Singh during the founding of the Khalsa on Baisakhi, 1699? Daya Ram from Lahore Himmat Singh from Puri Muhkam Chand from Dwarka Select the correct option from codes given below:

questions.explain: Daya Ram, Himmat Singh, and Muhkam Chand were among the original Panj Pyare initiated by Guru Gobind Singh on 30th March 1699, the day of founding Khalsa. Daya Ram was from Lahore, Himmat Singh from Puri, and Muhkam Chand from Dwarka. Each was assigned the surname ‘Singh’ and asked to maintain the five symbols known as the five K's.
